title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Corridor Development Investment Program (Tranche 2)

description.narrative: Tranche 2 is aligned with the overall design of the MFF with the impact of regional connectivity and trade in the CAREC corridors enhanced, and will have the following outcome and the outcome of efficiency for road traffic along the CAREC corridors improved. Tranche 2 will deliver the two outputs: (i) to dualize the 222-km Shikarpur-Rajanpur section of N55 on the existing alignment to make the section a four-lane carriageway; and (ii) to help NHA to implement its upcoming training program for 5 years (2021-2025).

Output: CAREC Corridor along N55 constructed or rehabilitated Indicator: 222 km from Shikarpur to Rajanpur improved with international roughness index no higher than 2.0m/km Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Lot 1 (Shikarpur-Kandhkot): Contract signed with Zahir Khan & Brothers (ZKB) on 20 Dec 2022 for PKR 8,848,101,910 ($35.39M equiv). Physical progress stands at 20.3%. Lot 1 has achieved 58.53 km of clearance, of which 44.41 km has been handed over for construction. An additional 14.12 km was recently cleared under the 7th IMR, while 3.89 km remains under LARP implementation.
Lot 2 (Kandhkot-Kashmore): Contract signed with China Civil Engineering Construction Corporation (CCECC) on 3 Jan 2023 for PKR 11,275,800,000 ($44.85M equiv). Physical progress stands at 6.50%. Lot 2 has achieved 43.36 km of clearance, including 36.80 km handed over for construction and 6.56 km validated in June 2025. However, 15.42 km, mainly covering the Kashmore Bypass, remains pending due to unpaid compensation.
Lot 3 (Kashmore-Rojhan): Contract signed with ZKB on 30 Dec 2022 for PKR 6,414,199,929 ($25.65M equiv). Physical progress stands at 54.05%. Lot 3 has achieved 47.10 km of clearance. Out of this, 6.15 km is currently on hold by EMA due to pending payments for unanticipated Displaced Persons (DPs). Accordingly, a total of 7.95 km (including 6.15 km under EMA hold) remains under LARP implementation. The Contractor is yet to submit a revised work program to complete the remaining works.
Lot 4 (Rojhan-Rajanpur): Contract signed with ZKB on 20 Dec 2022 for PKR 7,312,776,399 ($29.25M) equiv. Physical progress stands at 50.55%, progress is lagging behind schedule due to delays in implementation of LARP. Lot 4 has achieved 47.95 km of clearance, with 44.05 km handed over for construction. An additional 3.89 km was recently cleared, while 2.27 km remains under clearance process due to design changes resulting in additional unanticipated DPs. The Contractor is yet to submit a new revised work program to complete the remaining works.
